data: OmniMedVQA open portion, image-path grouped split; source and code in medical/prepare_omnimed.py
cpo: per-tensor top 10 percent nonzero movement, cumulative union, globally normalized L1 lambda 100
evaluation: after each stage all seen tasks, held-out test accuracy using boxed or explicit leading option letter; no test-driven tuning
reward_adaptation: accept boxed or explicit leading option letter because base model emits plain letters; same scorer for train and eval
differences_from_paper: Qwen2.5-VL-3B rather than Qwen3-VL-2B; 2 GPUs DDP rather than 8 GPUs DeepSpeed; TRL 0.26.2 vs code requirement 0.27; steps_per_generation 1, batch and accumulation differ; sdpa; OmniMedVQA custom split
retention: user authorized retain first and latest stage checkpoints and full results; intermediate stage checkpoints and masks are transient and removed only after a later stage is evaluated and its successor mask exists
hard_limits: elapsed 86100 sec, disk guard 40e9 bytes with single-output headroom under 50e9; no optimizer checkpoint saves
data_limit: Patient/study separation and cross-source duplicate images not established; no independent clinical claims
preflight: 24 sampled image decodes, CPU gradient accumulation, actual 2-GPU 6-step reward and optimizer, positive masked gradient and gradient checkpointing, CPU full-model mask, and 4-case evaluation
